headline: Sensex and Nifty trade volatile amid high oil prices; Dabur and Vascon Engineering in focus

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Brent crude prices remain elevated near $106 per barrel, impacting investor sentiment
Indian 10-year bond yields hit a 4-month low following a rout in US debt markets
The market is reacting to a significant 1,200-point drop in the Sensex during the previous session
High yields and global economic headwinds are weighing on the broader market recovery
whatHappening: Dabur India received NCLT approval for its merger with Ayurvedic hair oil brand Sesa Care
Vascon Engineering secured a new order worth ₹660 crore from Qualcomm India
NSE Chairman Ashish Chauhan hinted at a potential self-listing of the exchange on its own platform
Integrum Energy Infrastructure filed draft papers with SEBI to launch an initial public offering
summary: The Indian stock market is witnessing volatile movements with the Nifty 50 trading between 23,000 and 23,100. While high oil prices and bond yield shifts act as headwinds, corporate developments in Dabur and Vascon Engineering are providing specific interest. Investors remain cautious as the market attempts to recover from a sharp sell-off in the previous session.
